description: Land Acquisition - Narangamuwa & Kalugala, Araayaka D/S Division, Kegalle District
categorisation: This gazette content exclusively concerns land acquisition matters under the Land Acquisition Act. It contains detailed notices for the acquisition of specific land parcels (including descriptions, boundaries, extents, and location details) for public purposes. The content falls under "Land acquisitions, transfers, or disposals" as specified in the Land Gazettes (Type 4) category, and does not involve government personnel changes, organizational restructuring, or any of the other specialized categories.
